Verbatim copies of `artyfact-cf/packages/model/src/{schema,load,model-index,facts,validate}.ts` and the bundled rule packs, used only as the parity reference in `test/artyfact.test.ts`. The only edits point `@artyfact/rules` and `./sha256` at this package's `src/rules`, which is the same engine moved verbatim. artyfact-cf has no installed `node_modules`, so importing its sources by relative path does not resolve `@artyfact/rules`.
